reviewed_finding: Four actual one-entry rational Kraus matrices are built from two Cayley unit vectors. Native sums recompute ΣKᵀK=I, ΣKρKᵀ and its population kernel, plus post-composition by bit flip. Identity and normalized dephasing have the same population shadow yet differ at coherent inputs. The source H018 mixMat is unnormalized, so it is not silently declared CPTP.
